escena: SCENE (a marketing lead and a web developer preparing their company website for AI agents, mid-session at a shared desk): seen exactly from above, perpendicular, a matte ink-blue desk becomes a graphic plane. In the upper middle lies a current thin aluminium laptop, open flat toward the camera, its frameless screen showing a company website mid-audit with a side panel of structured data and a few green check marks, words too small to read. Overlapping its lower right corner lies a current tablet with minimal bezels showing a document page with a large plain light cover area and a short checklist below it, words too small to read; a stylus rests across it. One hand enters from the left edge with its index finger on the tablet's checklist, a second hand enters from the top right edge on the laptop trackpad; real skin with pores and creases. A ceramic cup of black coffee near the top left corner, a phone face down near the right edge. Hard daylight from the top left throws crisp short shadows of the laptop, the tablet and the hands across the desk. Efeonce blue lives in the desk itself; one small orange accent: the stylus. Nothing analog: no paper notebook, no printed sheets. Laptop and tablet sit in the upper 60% of the frame and in the central 70% of its width; the lower part of the frame is calm empty desk in shadow.
